; v. rev. akan ekpe november dead lists november dead list sheets and envelopes are now available in all churches. you are invited to take an envelope for the list and write down all your family deceased and others you know. when you have done this, then bring the envelope back to any mass in the parish or drop the envelope into the letterbox at the parochial houses. october devotions for this the last sunday in october with the glorious mysteries of the rosary, the prayer to st joseph, exposition of the blessed sacrament and benediction today from 7-7.40pm in st michael's church, clogherhead. all are welcome! rosary at the grottos you are also warmly welcome to join others in termonfechin parish to pray the rosary on thursday evening at 7.30pm. the final venue for october is the grotto in baltray on the 29". the rosary is recited in the church of the immaculate conception, termonfeckin 9am (before mass) on monday, tuesday & thursdays and after 9.30am mass in the church of the assumption, sandpit. all are welcome to come along. rosary in the cemeteries for november the rosary will be recited every sunday in november in mullary cemetery at 12.30pm starting on november 1”, all welcome, the rosary will also be recited in termonfechin parish cemeteries, starting in holy cross cemetery at 3pm next sunday 1" november and then in old cemetery on 8'" november, all welcome. eucharistic adoration - a time of quiet praise and blessing monday in termonfeckin church 7pm to 8pm. tuesday after mass in tenure church, wednesday in clogherhead church 10am to 11am and after mass in fieldstown. thursday after mass in dysart and friday after mass in dillonstown, for those unable to be present in person, we warmly invite you to join us online through the parish webcams. as scripture reminds us:“be still, and know that 1 am god.” — psalm 46:10 togher parish children choir practice on tuesday's from 5.45-6.30pm in dillonstown church. new members welcome. contact maria

. at fatima our lady promised that if we did what she asked there would be peace in the world and that many souls would be saved. carlingford/omeath red cross are holding a social in st. mary’s hall cooley on sunday november 8th. time from 4 to 7pm. music by kevin kearney. everyone is welcome, bring some friends. movement classes and social connections continue in cooley hall during the mid term. 45-minute active movement class every wednesday 10.45am. group walk for beginners and introduction to activator walking poles every wednesday from 12pm christmas craft fair at st patricks gfc on 15th nov 2026 10.a.m.- 4pm plenty of gifts for sale. jewellery, books, toys, knitwear, etc. coffee shop & cake sale. raffle on the day. the recent carlingford greenway walk for ms has raised at total of €5278.50. thanks to all who supported it. the irish cancer society is seeking compassionate volunteer drivers to join our pool of drivers. as a volunteer driver you would be bringing patients undergoing chemotherapy to the hospital and back home for their treatment. gifting your time means that cancer patients will have comfortable (one on one) transport to attend appointments for their lifesaving treatment. if you can spare 2 days per month, have a valid driving licence, and a safe, reliable vehicle, you are the perfect candidate to make a significant difference. the irish cancer society will provide you with training before you start as a driver for us. your generosity not only eases the journey for many during a challenging time but also offers comfort and support when it's needed most. for more information and to become a volunteer driver, please contact monica or emily at
